messages:
elaine: Quick one — filling out a customer security questionnaire (Acme). Q12: 'Describe log retention, redaction, and who can access raw request logs.' What text should I paste? We currently: keep request metadata + telemetry for 30 days, redact prompt/response bodies before S3, encrypt at rest with KMS, and grant access by role. Who can sign off?

jamal: Short: that matches current behaviour. One nuance: we occasionally capture full-request snapshots for debugging but only with an approved JIRA + expiring token, and those are stored <48h in a locked bucket.

sophia: +1. Suggested wording (copy/paste):

```
We retain structured request metadata and telemetry for 30 days for operational and security analysis. Customer-provided content (prompts and generated outputs) is removed or redacted by an automated de-identification pipeline prior to long-term storage; raw request/response bodies are not stored except for rare, time-limited debug snapshots performed with documented approval. All logs and backups are encrypted at rest with customer-independent CMKs managed in our KMS. Access to raw logs is limited to named operational and security roles via RBAC and audited; third-party subprocessors that process logs on our behalf are disclosed in our subprocessors matrix (e.g., AWS S3, Datadog) and are subject to contractual data protection controls.
```

sophia: That wording avoids saying "PII" explicitly and focuses on process.

elaine: Nice. For the subprocessors line — do we have an up-to-date list to paste? The questionnaire has a separate checkbox for 'do you use subprocessors for logging/storage?'.

jamal: Current list: AWS (S3, KMS), Datadog (metrics/traces), Sumo/Log-shipper deprecated but still in some customers; Rollbar for exceptions. I'll open a quick PR to sync the canonical list in the vendor spreadsheet.

tim: I can sign off on the wording if Sophia okays the compliance phrasing. Also confirm: "encrypted at rest with customer-independent CMKs" — for Dedicated/private customers we have different options; maybe add a short parenthetical?

sophia: Good catch. Change that sentence to: "All logs and backups are encrypted at rest (KMS-managed keys; customer-managed keys available for Dedicated/Private deployments)."

alex: FYI — when you paste into the questionnaire they sometimes want an exact retention number per log type. Jamal, can you confirm "30 days" applies to request metadata and 90 days for aggregated usage metrics?

jamal: Confirmed: request metadata/telemetry = 30d; aggregated, rollup metrics = 90d; error/exception traces = 180d by default. I'll put a short table in the vendor doc.

elaine: Perfect. Final question: who should be in the approval check box for 'security contact'? We usually list sec-questions@redwood.ai but Acme wants a named lead. Can we list Sophia + tim as points?

sophia: List Security (sec-questions@) and name me (Sophia Rivera) + Tim Park for escalation.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot posted a message: "Questionnaire draft saved to /shared/security/acme_q12_draft.md (rev 3)"

elaine: Thanks all — I'll paste Sophia's revised wording, include Jamal's retention numbers, attach the subprocessors sheet once Jamal's PR lands, and tag Sophia/Tim for sign-off. Will update thread when submitted. :thumbsup
